title: DiscDiff: Latent Diffusion Model for DNA Sequence Generation
dataset: EPD-GenDNA (introduced by this paper): HuggingFace Zehui127/*; 160k seqs, 15 species, 2048 & 256 bp

problem.statement: Generate realistic discrete DNA sequences (regulatory + protein-coding) across species. Standard continuous diffusion is ill-suited to discrete DNA; prior discrete DMs (DDSM, D3PM) are compute-heavy; latent diffusion suffers ROUNDING ERRORS converting latent->discrete, worst on long sequences.
problem.contribution: Three parts: (1) DiscDiff — the first Latent Diffusion Model for DNA: a two-stage VAE (discrete seq <-> continuous latent) + a U-Net denoiser trained in latent space. (2) Absorb-Escape — a post-training refinement algorithm that fixes single-nucleotide 'rounding errors' (low-softmax 'valleys') by locally re-generating with a pretrained autoregressive model (Hyena). (3) EPD-GenDNA — the first large multi-species DNA-generation dataset (160k seqs, 15 species, 2713 cell types).

stage1_vae.encoder: E = E_phi2 . E_phi1. First-stage E_phi1: N_4^L -> R^{K x M} (2D latent, K channels, M length). Second-stage E_phi2: R^{1 x K x M} -> R^{C x K' x M'} (3D latent, reduced dims).
stage1_vae.decoder: D = D_theta1 . D_theta2, symmetric to encoders. Reconstruction s~ = D(E(s)).
stage1_vae.loss: CE reconstruction loss (per-position 4-way categorical) + beta * KL(q_phi(z|s) || N(z;mu,Sigma)), isotropic prior (Eq in 4.1.2).
stage1_vae.note: Higher-dim latent helps the denoiser learn; two-stage architecture is the key design (Sec 4.1.1, ablation Table 4).

stage2_denoiser.objective: Standard DDPM epsilon-prediction in latent space: E_{z,t,eps} || eps - eps_theta(z_t, t) ||^2 (Eq 2).
stage2_denoiser.network: U-Net with ResNet blocks, optional self-attention, cross-attention on (species, time). Locked/frozen decoder at generation.
stage2_denoiser.conditioning: species + time embeddings via cross-attention (enables conditional multi-species generation).

absorb_escape.role: Post-training / inference-time refinement of a DiscDiff-generated sequence s, using a pretrained autoregressive model M (Hyena) and the diffusion decoder's per-position max-softmax L(D, s_i).
procedure: ABSORB: trigger at position i when absorb condition A(s_i) is true.
AUTOREGRESSIVE GEN: from position i, re-generate with M.
ESCAPE: continue until escape condition E(s_j) holds, then replace the low-prob region of s with M's generation.

conditions_table3.absorb: A(s_i) = true  iff  L(D, s_i) < T_absorb   (diffusion is UNconfident here)
conditions_table3.escape_natural: E(s_j) = true  iff  L(D, s_j) > L(M, s_j)   (diffusion regains confidence over AR)  [DEFAULT]
conditions_table3.escape_threshold: E(s_j, T_escape) = true  iff  L(M, s_j) < T_escape
conditions_table3.escape_random: E(s_j, T_random) = true  iff  uniform(0,1) > T_random
conditions_table3.escape_maxlen: E(s_j, max_sub_length) = true  iff  j > max_sub_length

absorb_escape.note: Absorb-Escape is a deterministic algorithm over softmax coefficient arrays; it can be verified with synthetic confidence profiles containing known 'valleys' (Fig 4: TATT -> TATA) WITHOUT any trained weights. This is the core, cheaply-checkable contribution.

dataset_epd_gendna.source: built on EPD (Eukaryotic Promoter Database, Meylan et al. 2020); ~300M wet-lab experiments

metrics.S-FID: Sei Frechet Inception Distance: FID in the latent space of a pretrained genomic model (Sei). LOWER better.
metrics.CorTATA: Pearson correlation of the TATA-box (and Initiator etc.) motif frequency distribution vs natural DNA. HIGHER better.
metrics.Diversity: avg pairwise distance among generated seqs; report Delta-Div = |Div_gen - Div_natural| (match natural). LOWER better.

absorb_escape_algorithm.why: Table 3 conditions + Fig 4 procedure fully specified: absorb when L(D,s_i)<T_absorb, natural escape when L(D)>L(M). Deterministic over softmax arrays; CPU-verifiable with synthetic valleys.

vae_ldm_architecture.why: Two-stage VAE + latent U-Net + eps-prediction (Eq 2) described; exact U-Net config is in Appendix C (partial). Reproducible in structure; exact channel/dim values need the appendix + code.

results_metrics.why: S-FID needs the Sei genomic model; full generation needs trained DiscDiff weights + Hyena + EPD-GenDNA. Numbers (Table 5: 3.21/4.38 S-FID) taken verbatim; reproduction is weight+data-gated.

dataset.why: EPD-GenDNA on HuggingFace (Zehui127/*); loadable but large. Same dataset D3LM uses.
